title: Influence bound for bribed tribes
statement: For nonnegative integers $w$ and $s$, a set $J$ of coordinates of the $(sw)$-dimensional sign cube, and a coordinate $i$, consider the tribes function with $s$ blocks of width $w$, after setting the coordinates in $J$ to $+1$. Its influence in coordinate $i$ is at most $1/2^{w-1}$.
